title: C1 operation body (validated per operation)
description: Common request-body skeleton for C1 write operations. Every C1 body declares contract_version: "v1" and carries operation-specific fields validated by the handler. Authorization and Idempotency-Key are header parameters, never body fields. A client-supplied provenance/actor field is rejected.

contract_version.description: Contract major version. Only 'v1' is defined.
